sloka: सो ऽपि प्रहृष्टस्तान् सर्वान् हरीन् प्रत्यभ्यपूजयत् ।हनुमान् सत्त्वसम्पन्नो यथार्हमनुकूलतः ।। ६.५६.३६ ।।।।
transliteration: so 'pi prahṛṣṭastān sarvān harīn pratyabhyapūjayat ।hanumān sattvasampanno yathārhamanukūlataḥ ।। 6.56.36 ।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman also who was richly endowed with goodness greatly honoured all the Vanaras accordingly.
